description.en:
A young man named Shi Quan lives alone, leading a simple and uneventful life. Unbeknownst to him, he is injected with a mysterious power that allows him to control his own blood. Yet, he has no knowledge of where this ability came from, nor any memory of his past. Though his memories are lost, fragments of his former life haunts him.

An encounter with an alien named Monday begins to unravel the secrets of his past; an all-powerful corporation, a crumbling old-world order, strange extraterrestrial beings, and superpowered humans. On the stage of this new world, Shi Quan embarks on an unexpected adventure alongside his companions, seeking the truth behind his blood and the memories buried deep within.

Which one do you prefer to cherish, the one you broke up with nine years ago or the new lover who has come to your heart?

Yanzhi Xu is the talented new lawyer at Tai He law firm… and he has a complicated, romantic past with its handsome star lawyer, Zongze Li. Despite a painful breakup, Zongze still has feelings for Yanzhi, who just wants to move on. Yanzhi may have the chance to do just that with Lei Pei, an intern who aims to impress with his legal chops, innocent charm, and hard body. In this battle for love and affection, will Yanzhi’s heart succumb to the advances from a past lover or move on with a hot, young protégé?

Qual você prefere amar, aquele com quem você terminou há nove anos ou o novo amante que chegou de mansinho ao seu coração?


Yanzhi Xu é o talentoso novo advogado do escritório de advocacia Tai He... e tem um passado complicado e romântico com o seu belo advogado estrela, Zongze Li. Yanzhi pode ter a oportunidade de fazer exatamente isso com Lei Pei, um estagiário que pretende impressionar com o seu talento jurídico, charme inocente, e belo corpo. Expecting a timeless romance with all kinds of prince charming, she instead discovered she's destined to be buried alongside the king at the royal funeral! In the Ghana tribe's tradition, upon the king's demise, his harem transfers to the prince who ascends the throne. Yet, the eldest prince refused her, leaving her condemned to a fiery fate! To make matters worse, she's accused of witchcraft! Death is not an option! Let's join the journey and witness Queen Eleanor's struggle in this magical realm as she strives to defy the odds and rewrite her destiny...

Según la costumbre de Gnar, cuando el rey muere, su harén pasa al príncipe que le sucede, pero el príncipe mayor no la acepta, ¡así que tiene que ser quemada en la hoguera! Es más, ¡la acusaron de ser una bruja! Veamos cómo Eleanor, la princesa, puede salvar el día en este reino mágico con su propia fuerza…

She needs someone to rely on in this world, and he is her “chance.” In fact, the fates have long foretold their love for each other, like a curse that stretches across millennia, these two will always find each other in every lifetime.

description.en: A group of friends wanders into an abandoned hospital unaware of the horrors awaiting them inside. The hospital harbors terrifying creatures, and the group can only do so much to survive. A horrific suspense story following a group of friends in a fight to survive the Hospital of Hell

title.en: When My Sect Is Destroyed and I Am Invincible

altTitles.zh: 弟子超神我躺平，宗门毁灭我无敌

description.en: He’s the lord of the Nanna Tribe, and she’s a human princess with a divine bloodline. After the great human-god war, she turned into a phoenix for love while he harbored a soul. After reincarnating and waiting, they reunited. He’s still the almighty overlord who watches over the cold corpse on the jade bed, while she has possessed the body of a mortal and had forgotten everything about the past. He plays the Soul Attraction Song tirelessly in the hopes of making her remember her past as she stumbles along in a different dream…

A youngster called Zhang Mo from the Northeast, who has been tormented by a curse since childhood, until a mysterious girl called Bai Zhizhi showed up, and wrecked his muddled jobless life. Under her threats, Zhang Mo ventured deep into the mountains, and awakened a mysterious man called Mu Cha who had been in slumber in Shek Pik (an area located along the southwestern coast of Lantau Coast, Hongkong). He then learned of a unprecedented world that is unlike the modern world, with the only choice of going along with two people of unknown origins who aspire to be shamans, to win a "battle" to rid of the curse, however...

title.en: Ten Promises Between Me and Him

altTitles.es: Diez promesas entre él y yo

altTitles.zh-ro: Wo He Ta De Shi Ge Yue Ding

description.es: “¡Firmar este contrato debe mantenerse en secreto!” Han Shuo, quien siempre ha sido considerado como el portavoz de “Stupid Sweet”, nunca pensó en lo que significaba firmar el contrato de Lin Yijie. La vida sencilla y apasionada del campus nunca ha regresado. En cambio, rodeé a Lin Yijie, el gran problema número uno en el cielo, y lo bloqueé del acoso de los jefes de la escuela y las flores de la escuela hasta que …

title.en: Falls in Love with a 300-Year-Old Girl

altTitles.en: Falls in Love with a 300 Year Old Girl

description.en: Lin Zuning was recently dumped by his girlfriend. Depressed and angry, he rode his motorcycle in the rain. Speeding as he went, he was met with an accident and broke his leg. He thought that he would be stranded there before someone rescues him, but instead he saw a little girl. Her name is Yulan and she is an angel working under divine orders to cause such accidents. It was an encounter that would change both of their lives. The story revolves around the angel's three lives reincarnated in Ancient China - all in which she meets and falls in love with the same person, but due to fate, she can never be together with him. And so starts a bittersweet story between Lin Zuning and Yulan, as they slowly discover just how much their fates are intertwine together in their past lives.

Princess Hakunamatata of Mongolia was sent to Imperial China to marry the young emperor so that she can become the new empress. However, the emperor already has a benevolent and loving wife, and he does not wish to take in a new wife. Already angry that her new "husband" is weak, timid, and puny, the rejected Princess Hakunamatata began to create endless trouble in the Palace! She is straightforward and fearless, and does whatever she wants! Instead of confronting Princess Hakunamatata, the empress decides to betroth her to the emperor's uncle, who finds the princess absolutely intolerable. Amidst all the hilarity and misunderstanding, a conspiracy is slowly emerging from the shadows - and all four characters' fate will change forever.
What will show the right path to those who wander between life and death...? An up-and-coming fantasy fiction story!
description.ja: 生と死をたゆたうものに正しき道を示すのは…。新進気鋭の伝奇ストーリー！

description.en: The practitioner's Dan energy originates from the moon sun and five elements, the body has five elements, since all living things have the five elements, regarding the issue if humans can train the Dan, there are two main views: one party believes using people will result in many difficulties, thus they only use the elemental energy from external sources, they are called true practitioners, the other party believes the body is the supreme thing under the heavens, in order to increase their strength exponentially, they use other people, they are called nefarious practitioners. True practitioners and nefarious practitioners' battle, is now unfolding!!! - Gamernissem

title.en: What Intentions Can the Miss Harbor?

altTitles.zh: 大小姐能有什么坏心眼呢

altTitles.en: What Bad Intentions Can the Eldest Miss Have?
What Evil Schemes Can the Eldest Lady Plan?

description.en: After many years of planning, Tong Yue has vowed to get revenge on all those who have insulted and humiliated her, as well as make them pay the price. However, she was interrupted by the handsome, high-powered businessman, Han Tianlin, who appeared out of nowhere, as she was ripping her enemies apart. How should she face the lover who she once blacklisted? Tong Yue expressed that in order to deal with him, a smack was enough.

For him cheating is like breathing air and he can never forget about his ex girlfriend. As the old saying goes, love yourself and stay away from assholes. But you can't retrieve the water that you poured out. An adventure of time travel to reform an asshole. May all true love in the world always find a happy ending!

Transmigrating as a slave maidservant with a weak and powerless master, let’s see how the maidservant Youli leads her crybaby Second Miss to the pinnacle of life. But there’s always this little handsome boy that forces her to rob the cradle. She doesn’t even have the time… Wait, Second Miss, please don’t do this! Put that water barrel down!

In the short period of 20 years after iMood was born, the society seems to be in harmony, but the hidden crisis is the collapse of human emotions. Yu Qing Le is a police officer who also has an iMood addiction. The overture of a serial killer started from a dead woman nailed to the ceiling…

title.en: This Love Is Like a Song

description.en: The capital’s unparalled hero, the one whose name resonated across the lands, Ling Yunge, had battled and won the world for the man she loved the most. She elevated him to become the crown prince, but in exchange all he gave her was deceit and lies. In her sorrow and pain, she disappeared. When she finally returned, she was a beauty that could summon the heavens with a single look…and she eventually got her revenge, and understood just who was worth keeping by her side. What she did not know, however, was that this was all a set up by Mu Yunlan. In the end, just what is the truth anymore?
description.zh: 京城里所向披靡，名震天下的凌云歌为自己心爱的人赢来了天下，将他送上太子之位，却换回了他的背叛与欺骗。她伤心欲绝，受尽折磨，再度归来之时，是得之可得天下的真命天女…… 终于，她大仇得报，也看到了一直守护在她身边的人。可谁知，这一切也不过是暮云岚的一场算计。然而，事情的真相真的是这样吗？

description.en:
Once upon a time there was an innocent and straightforward little Aries girl. 

After being targeted by a black-bellied Leo boy and by using food to lure her to him, she couldn't resist the Leo boy at all!

The boy said : "I'm determined to be there whenever you need me, I'll accompany you wherever, eat, drink, and even finish up all the vegetables that you hate. I'll do my best to make you happy, so just be with me."

The girl said : "It always has been you who came for me."

description.en:
A failed youth pill turns the pretty Pozsi, a resident witch of FairyLand, into a little girl. She is dating the handsome and kind Prince Yvrin, but how will he react when he sees his beloved Pozsi as a child? Is there a cure?  
  
This series references many popular fairy tale stories by mixing in its own little twists and showing these popular tales from a whole new perspective, the perspective of a witch!

description.en:
After dying in the modern world, the protagonist transmigrates into a cliché romance novel—but not as the heroine or villainess. Instead, she becomes the neglected only daughter of the story’s infamous "overbearing CEO" male lead and his canon wife (a gentle but doomed character).

Now stuck in the body of a pampered but lonely child, she must:

Survive the chaotic plot: Her "cold CEO dad" is too busy tormented by misunderstandings with the female lead, while her "mom" is destined to die tragically.

Fix her family: Using her adult knowledge, she schemes to prevent her parents’ divorce, expose scheming antagonists, and maybe teach her emotionally stunted dad how to be a decent human.

Avoid doom flags: The original story’s timeline threatens her cushy life as the CEO’s heir.
description.zh: 她不是纯情小白花女主，不是美艳无脑女二，甚至不是女主的热心闺蜜女三…… 她是霸总和娇妻的独生女，是带球跑中的那个“球”。 什么？你说这听起来不错？

description.en: Gu Xueyi was born in a general family, and was the mistress of the Sheng family during her lifetime. She was in charge of a large family of more than 400 people, and she was extremely prosperous. When she woke up, she was told that she had slipped into a book and became a boss man who was going to be divorced and destined to die early. Lord's ex-wife. Seeing her husband feasting on his crooked younger siblings, Gu Xueyi pinched her wrist. It was none of her business whether her husband wanted a divorce. The top priority was to teach these useless things to the right path

altTitles.en: Waiting for You to Embrace Me

description.en: Upon returning to China after four years, Jiang Qi, a successful and independent woman, thought she had let go of the feelings she had missed, but a traffic accident made her meet the last person she would want to see! Her ex-boyfriend, Fu Sen, who thought their fate was over, broke into her life again. Can the love that has been silent in each other's hearts for a long time to be accurately conveyed to each other? I may not understand love, but it was you who let me grow to know about it. [Exclusive/Irregular Update Editor: Aki]

In order to save his childhood savior, Cha Wenbin, the head of Mao Mountain, the genius doctor Xia Yi ventured into Cha Wenbin's subconscious and tried to awaken him, but found that Cha Wenbin's consciousness was trapped in his memories 13 years ago. What surprised Xia Yi even more, was that Cha Wenbin was imprisoned here voluntarily. In order to find and unravel Cha Wenbin's knot, Xia Yi embarked on a thrilling adventure in the world of consciousness!

altTitles.en: I Have Revived the Chinese Gods!

description.en: Glaciers are melting, and the sea clans are invading. The Western gods rule over humanity, while the Huaxia people, without gods, become the target of everyone. Until a giant stone statue crosses the starry sky and crashes into the land of Jiuzhou, Zhao Feiyu comes through the void...

[Yaoqi Village 2024 Spring - Super Short Comic Bronze Award] A high school student, Jiajia, was suddenly pushed down the stairs from behind when she was leaving the school. When she woke up in the emergency room and wanted to identify the culprit who pushed her, her homeroom teacher, Miss Zhang, stopped her at all costs. At this time, Jia Jia's consciousness began to waver, she wasn’t even sure if she had remembered wrong...

title.en: The Girl in the Time Archive

description.en: Chen Xiaoshi finds herself unemployed and single. By chance, she gains the ability to acess the time archive. This grants her the ability to travel back in time to her days as a university student. She attempts to use this newfound ability to alter her tragic life. In the end, will she succeed in changing her fate?

Strange events are rampant, grieved souls are everywhere, and people's lives are disturbed. In order to deal with the constantly appearing spirits, the royal family created a profession called "Spiritual Master." They travel around and use special methods to transcend the resentment of the spirits. When the bell rings and the night falls, they will accompany the fading green flames until the very last moment...

A teenage girl returns to her hometown and is reunited with a childhood sweetheart. The shadows of the past have turned them into strangers. As they adjust to life, they experience and feel everything: envy and longing, arrogance and prejudice, the light and bitter aroma of mint, just like their youth. The obscure love of boys and girls, the young heartbeat, and the confusion and expectations of the future…
At well-known University 985, there's 320 dorm. Because the four people in the dormitory have different personalities but all look very handsome, they are known as 320F4. Here is their little story.

description.en: I am a middleman between good and evil, and the owner of Tianwai Clinic. I can cure all diseases and do the way for heaven! Who would have thought that my story started with a dog, who sent me a clinic that night…
A snake-woman?! A flower fairy?! A fox spirit?! Why have you all appeared on my bed? I’m begging you, leave me alone! I just want to be a normal high school student, ahhhhhh!
A meeting on the bus to the underworld. Fate… Responsibility… To face it all or to run away?

Betrayed by her sister and her lover, prodigious Tang Xueyan was on the verge of death. However, just as she reached her demise, Xueyan was reincarnated in the Purple Moon Realm 200 years later, into the body of Nangong Xue - the eldest daughter of the Nangong Family. Nangong Xue used to be a prodigious cultivator too, until she fell prey to an evil plot set up by her brother, lost her cultivation, and ended up useless, weak, and crippled. From the moment Tang Xueyan was reincarnated into Nangong Xue's body, she swore to protect her loved ones and unleash vengeance upon her enemies!

Hey, I’m doing this to help you improve your cultivation, not to slack off~

description.en: In a world infested with "subhumans", the lives of humans are full of danger and fear. But along with the existence of "subhumans" is the existence of "reapers" whose livelihoods are to protect humans and rid world of "subhumans". Among their ranks is one who is famous for being the true "reaper" but his identity remains a mystery.

Since time immemorial, it has been said that there exists a Spirit Realm. Throughout the dynasties, renowned scholars and literati have spoken of it in various ways, and a poem records: “From Qi to Tang, this mountain grew desolate, the Spirit Realm lay silent, seldom visited by man. The Spirit Realm cannot be described, its ghostly craftsmanship is hard to seek.”
description.vi:
Từ xưa đến nay, thiên hạ vẫn lưu truyền về sự tồn tại của Linh Cảnh. Những lời đồn đại quanh Linh Cảnh qua các triều đại đều muôn hình vạn trạng, các danh sĩ thi nhân xưa cũng từng ghi lại trong thơ rằng:
*“Từ thời Tề đến Đường, núi này hoang vu, Linh Cảnh tịch mịch, hiếm người lui tới. Linh Cảnh vốn khó hình dung, bàn tay thần quỷ cũng khó mà tìm được.”*
description.zh: 亘古通今，传闻世有灵境。关于灵境的说法，历朝历代的名人雅士众说纷纭，诗中记载： “自齐至唐，兹山濅荒，灵境寂寥，罕有人游。灵境不可状，鬼工谅难求。”

description.en:
Wu Lian and Gu Xiaochen are classmates who have very different positions and social standing. After four years, when Xiaoclihen joins a company as an employee, she finds out Wu Lian is her boss!. A heartwarming and quirky love story between a playboy and the timid violet of the office!

---
This is a story of a Cinderella who meets a bad-tempered prince. 

We all want to live a wonderful life. and we may never ask for a life that is so gorgeous and charming, or a love that is so exciting. All we ask for is to exist in peace and security, and that is an indispensable part of a wonderful life. The momentary fragrance is just a blink of an eye, and so is love.

description.zh: 心潮澎湃，无限幻想，迎风挥击千层浪，少年不败热血！ 朝天大陆，青山剑宗，孤峰里生出一道剑光，一剑斩天！景阳师叔祖飞升之后，白衣少年井九自山中来，向故山行。以美貌与懒惰而闻名的井九，修行之路与众不同，独辟蹊径。景阳飞升背后疑窦重重，青山诸峰的云雾之中隐藏何许也？

title.en: Her Royal Highness the Dragon Lady was counterattacked

description.id: Ao Xin, putri bungsu Raja Naga Laut Cina Timur, bercita-cita menjadi dewi perang wanita tampan seperti Xuanny Sembilan Surga yang legendaris! Tapi karena terpaksa pindah sekolah, Ao Xin menjadi satu- satunya murid surgawi di Surga Taoyuan... Sekolah baru tidak hanya "buruk" dari siswa hingga guru, tapi juga... meja yang sama adalah minyak yang sangat besar botol! "Siapa tahu, anggota keluarga, ketika kamu naik level dan melawan monster, kamu harus bertanggung jawab merawat anak baru... Tapi bagaimana jika dia benar-benar tampan?" - kata Xiao Longnui.
description.zh: 东海龙王家的小女儿敖辛，梦想是成为像传说中的九天玄女那样帅气的女战神！ 但因被迫转学，敖辛成为了桃源福地唯一一名天仙弟子…… 新学校不仅从学生到老师都在“摆烂”，还有……同桌是个巨大无比的拖油瓶！ “谁懂啊家人们，升级打怪时还得负责带萌新……可是他真的好好看怎么办？”——小龙女如是说道。
